d: Giannis Antetokounmpo put together a monster performance against the New York Knicks, finishing with 22 points, 23 rebounds, and 3 assists while setting a new career-high in rebounds. Giannis recorded his first 20-point, 20-rebound game of the season and the 11th of his career, while also posting his fourth first-half double-double of the season. His dominant performance helped the Miami Heat secure a hard-fought 108-105 victory, keeping their momentum going in NBA Cup play. Miami also improved to 7-0 when Giannis and Bam Adebayo both score 20 or more points.
